title: Chapter 845
text:
Author: I am the Fallen Immortal. My nickname is the cute little fairy. I think it's a girl. I tried it, and it turned out to be a guy. Even better.

The title of the book is "I am the Legendary Boss." If you are interested, you can take a look.

Introduction:

What if he transmigrated to become an NPC?

This thought took root and germinated in William's mind!

Thus, he decided.

He wanted to become the strongest NPC in history.

He wanted to stack the thickest armor and take the most vicious hits!

Who said that NPCs had to be killed by players?

Who said that NPCs had to level up slower than players?

Who said that NPCs had to drop equipment? I can drop even more … Bah, bah, bah.

Anyway, it was impossible for him to die. He could only bluff the players and NPCs and live a life of hooliganism.

Sigh, the chosen one in front, please wait. I see that you are unafraid of death and have an iron head. How about I sell this Legendary helmet to you for 100,000 gold coins?

Recommended book for "Godly Mechanic"
